task: harmonic scoring rule comparison; NOT the full Maezawa or Pardo score followers
candidate_vocabulary: each song's full set of written chord labels, shared across methods; no timed input labels

yamaha.equation: log p_h(x|s=i) up to an additive constant = x^T T_ci,ri + x^T m
yamaha.implemented: binary currently held MIDI21..108; chord template tiled over pitch octaves; absent melody m=0
yamaha.underspecified: published numerical templates and piano-roll value encoding unavailable
yamaha.chosen_defaults: binary active roll, binary explicit chord tones; separately labeled soft-template sensitivity
yamaha.not_implemented: trained TCN/downbeat network, HHSMM/tempo dynamics, melody, or accompaniment

pardo.source: Pardo and Birmingham 2002 Algorithms for Chordal Analysis, pp.28-31
pardo.equation: S=P-(M+N); note weight = number of note-event minimal segments spanned
pardo.implemented: published score, minimal-segment weights, optional root-weight tie rule
pardo.adaptations: causal sliding windows rather than complete segmentation; adds chord qualities absent from the native vocabulary while restricting candidates to this song's chart labels
pardo.not_implemented: CHORD global segmentation/optimization or Pardo lead-sheet sequence follower

accuracy.primary: correct annotation among k tied top labels yields 1/k, otherwise 0; absent input yields 0
accuracy.provenance: Pardo2002 ambiguity-credit rule adapted from minimal segments to common 100-ms frames
accuracy.secondary: alphabetical-tie top1 reproduces previous-pilot convention; unique-correct and coverage also saved
accuracy.aggregation: equal mean across three songs, preferred and alternate separate

controls: cosine vs dot on same active88 or minimal-segment representation to isolate scoring effects
alignment: original MIDI zero origins, no fitted shifts; annotation/audio not independently reverified
